name: EvilDrac
bio:
EvilDrac, also known as Drac, is an Admin on Silver Springs Survival. He first joined in 2012 with a friend after discovering the server through Planet Minecraft.

Although he doesn’t spend as much time in-game these days, Drac still follows what’s happening on the server and enjoys seeing what the community creates. He stayed because of the warm, friendly atmosphere and the custom features that give Silver Springs its own identity.

One of his favorite memories is the VoidTek Takeover, which brought an antagonist side to the Silver Springs story. He also has a soft spot for the old Greek-themed spawn.

Drac’s advice for new players is to take their time, ask for advice whenever they want it, and try something new without feeling overwhelmed. Outside of Minecraft, he enjoys Overwatch, The Outlast Trials, and Palworld, along with streaming and spending time with his girlfriend.
history:
EvilDrac became a Moderator on March 2nd, 2015 (along with MrJoned) and was an Admin starting July 15th of the same year up until January 1st, 2018, when he stepped down to the Mod position for personal reasons.
